name: Exage 500LX
generation: Documented in Shimano’s 1990 manufacturer dealer manual, earlier than the 1991/1992 references previously reviewed. The start year records the first reviewed dated availability reference, not a claimed launch year.

sources.title: Shimano 1992 dealer product manual, PDF page 33 / printed 30: Exage 500LX exact inventory: RD-M500-SGS 329 g and separate GS limits; FD-M500-B/FD-M500 band options; FC-M500-SG 170 mm 48/38/28T 756 g, separate BB-M550 339 g and PD-M450 518 g per pair
Shimano 1991 dealer product manual, PDF page 71 / printed 68: Exage 500LX named range: unsuffixed FC-M500 170 mm 48/38/28T 756 g, separately listed BB-M550, BL-M451-A 340 g per pair and BR-M454

Shimano 1990 dealer product manual, PDF page 55 / printed 52: Exage 500LX: FD-M500 118 g normal band with sole 28.0–28.6 mm band; CS-HG50 E 12–28T seven-speed 325 g with spacers; BB-M500 and ST-M050 rear-labelled reference
